clue.text: Brontës angrily tangling with French cabinetmakers!

explanation.definitionFit: A noel is a traditional song celebrating the Nativity, sung in the festive season.

clue.text: Extra Times edition's leader

clue.text: Jack ruins ceremony by inviting Republican party leader
